hero.headline: I am eager to drive growth at ePlus Inc.
hero.subheadline: I'm excited about supporting ePlus Inc.'s sales team with my BDR and digital marketing experience. This role aligns perfectly with my skills in order management and customer relations, and I look forward to contributing to ePlus's continued success.

whyCompany.title: Innovative IT Solutions Leader
whyCompany.body: ePlus Inc. is renowned for its cutting-edge IT solutions, which is exciting to be part of. I admire how ePlus supports innovation across diverse industries, making it an ideal place for a dynamic starter like me.

whyCompany.title: Expanding Opportunities
whyCompany.body: At this moment, ePlus Inc.'s growth provides a unique opportunity to contribute to its thriving sales team. The chance to help manage and expand existing customer relationships is stimulating and rewarding.

whyCompany.title: Utilizing Sales and Marketing Skills
whyCompany.body: My experience as a BDR at Copygen.ai laid a strong foundation in sales, and my role at NextAfter honed my marketing skills. These experiences are ideal for excelling as a Sales Support Rep at ePlus.

quote: I am thrilled to bring my sales and marketing expertise to ePlus and help redefine customer success.
